name: Value sources
rule: Literal values, field references and expressions are alternative ways to obtain values. Retain their distinct public properties and evaluation contexts. A field reference can identify a writer-inferable dependency; an arbitrary expression does not establish an inverse.
exceptions: Do not replace sizeFromField with an equivalent-looking expression. Fixed sizes remain constraints. Preserve units, scope, exact integer conversion, absence and inheritance for each consuming property.

name: Ordered selection
rule: Ordered conditional rules select the first applicable rule. This common description does not supply a universal fallback or evaluation phase.
exceptions: Type selection retains dispatchDefault/dataType fallback and its missing-type error. Mapping, cell type, dimension order and byte order retain their own activation, defaults and errors. Keyed dispatch collects uniquely keyed arms across the graph; it is not an ordered predicate list.

name: Encoding shorthand
rule: isEncodedWith denotes a single unparameterized codec. hasEncodingStep is an ordered pipeline in encoder order; decoding traverses that order in reverse.
exceptions: Preserve mutual exclusion, parameters, codec framing, decoded address space, region bounds and capability rejection. A pipeline description does not imply that every parser or writer supports it.

name: Constraint reuse
rule: Private authoring fragments expand into the existing shapes before publication. Targets stay on their original shapes; reusable value constraints do not acquire domain-wide activation.
exceptions: Preserve the exact datatype alternatives, RDF list order, count and numeric bounds, messages, severity and result structure. Similar-looking raster and sampling constraints are not interchangeable.
